title: Charis dictionary
description: Structured lemma-rendering dictionary. Authority over DICT.txt. Semantic rules beyond this schema (duplicate Strong's claims, one lemma per language per entry, I2 absolute English-term ownership) are enforced by tool/dict.ts lintDict.

id.description: Stable slug; never reused after deletion.

rendering.description: Primary English term / transliteral: the default at every occurrence not selected by a sense alternate. Null while undecided. Owned by this entry alone (I2).

senses.description: Alternate English terms owned by this source term (P1). Each alternate's rendering is owned by this entry alone (I2). Selection must be exhaustive and mechanical before status decided (PR3).

rationale.description: Required (non-null) when status is decided or applied — I6.

forms.description: Explicit English conjugation forms of the rendering (e.g. quench, quenched, quenching). When present, impute/check-mapping match these exactly instead of prefix-stemming — this is what makes the writing pass deterministic.

decided.description: ISO date the rendering was decided.

strongs.description: H-prefix for heb/arc, G-prefix for grk (cross-checked by dict-lint).

translit.description: Project transliteration per the README mapping tables.

lemma.description: Conventional romanized lemma name (heb); Greek script for grk — the MorphGNT key.

terms.description: Headwords of this entry (rendering / sense renderings) this lemma carries. Omitted = all. Required when the entry holds several lemmas of one language; each headword binds to at most one lemma per language (P1).

rendering.description: The alternate English term; distinct from every term any other entry owns.

adjudication.description: PR3 collapse-test note: why this alternate survives.

forms.description: Explicit conjugation forms of this alternate (e.g. become, became, becometh). Exact-match, like the entry-level forms; owned by this entry (I2).
